//: The judge panel. EDIT THIS FILE to change judges - no code changes needed.
//1: Each 'slot' is 'provider/model'. Any provider/model named here is registered
//2: on the fly against that provider's API key.
//4: STRATEGY: one judge per provider, each on its OWN free channel - so we don't
//5: stress OpenRouter's shared quota and every model runs at full free access:
//6: - zai/glm-5.1                              -> latest GLM, free via Z.ai (ZAI_API_KEY)
//7: - nvidia/.../nemotron-ultra-253b-v1        -> 253B Nemotron Ultra, free via NVIDIA NIM (NVIDIA_API_KEY)
//9: - cerebras/qwen-3-235b...                  -> largest Qwen, free via Cerebras (CEREBRAS_API_KEY)
//11: 4 providers, 4 model families => maximally uncorrelated critiques. A judge
//12: whose provider 429s or whose key is missing just returns ok:false; the rest
//13: still run. To swap any judge to a better native channel, sign up there and
//14: change its slot string (add the provider to providers.py if it's new).

judges.note: latest GLM via Z.ai's own API (full free access)
253B Nemotron Ultra via NVIDIA NIM data centers (free credits)
DeepSeek-R1 free on OpenRouter; native deepseek API exists if you want to upgrade
largest Qwen, very fast (Cerebras free tier)
